scale.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-white

metric_cards.style: relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-[#11183C] border border-white/10 p-5 shadow-xl hover:border-cyan-500/40 transition-all duration-300 group

buttons.primary: w-full sm:w-auto px-6 py-3.5 rounded-xl font-semibold text-white bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 to-blue-600 hover:from-cyan-400 hover:to-blue-500 shadow-lg shadow-cyan-500/25 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.whatsapp: w-full sm:w-auto px-6 py-3.5 rounded-xl font-semibold text-white bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 shadow-lg shadow-emerald-600/30 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: w-full sm:w-auto px-6 py-3.5 rounded-xl font-semibold text-slate-200 bg-slate-800/80 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-white/10 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all

status_badges.pending: px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20
status_badges.in_progress: px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/20
status_badges.completed: px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20
status_badges.urgent: px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/20 animate-pulse

dropdown_and_modals.rule: NEVER use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals. Always use solid high-density dark surfaces (#11183C or #18224B) with clear white borders (border-white/15) and full opacity shadow-2xl.
dropdown_and_modals.dialog_content: bg-[#11183C] border border-cyan-500/30 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl text-white p-6 backdrop-blur-none opacity-100

templates.ticket_created: Olá! Seu chamado #{ticket_id} para o equipamento {printer_model} foi aberto com sucesso na PoliPrint. Nosso técnico entrará em contato em breve.
templates.ticket_assigned: Técnico {tech_name} a caminho! Chamado #{ticket_id}. Acompanhe em tempo real pelo PoliPrint App.
templates.ticket_finished: Chamado #{ticket_id} finalizado por {tech_name}. Obrigado por escolher a PoliPrint!
templates.supply_order: Pedido de Suprimento #{order_id} registrado! Itens: {items_summary}. Status: {status}.

whatsapp_automation.ui_triggers: Distinctive WhatsApp Green (#10B981) button with official icon, instant message composer preview modal, and automated dispatch via backend API (Twilio).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components use .js / .jsx file extensions (React JavaScript).
Maintain the dark navy (#000B2E) backdrop with cyan (#12BAFF) accents across all role dashboards.
Include high-contrast data-testid attributes on all buttons, inputs, tabs, cards, and interactive elements.
Implement real-time action flows: open tickets, assume tickets, finish tickets, clock in/out, order supplies, WhatsApp messaging.
Ensure zero transparent dropdown backgrounds; popovers and selects must have solid bg-[#11183C] surfaces.
For WhatsApp integrations, combine automatic backend triggers with direct wa.me fallback buttons on ticket cards.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_rule: MUST add data-testid on every button, input, tab, card, badge, modal, and key text element.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.color_discipline: Never use pure white background or generic blue (#0284c7). Stick to the NavyStack hierarchy (#000B2E, #11183C, #12BAFF).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.interactivity: All list items must have hover scale effects, glow borders on focus, and explicit active visual states.
